Reviewer unavailability is decided at a single point (reviewer_dispatch_unavailable) consulted by the dispatch, adoption probe, state read and pool loop; GitHubUnavailable is excluded so exhausted retries stay fail-closed. collect_attempts catches only ReviewerDispatchRefused, preventing post-trigger failures from being rewritten as zero-id refusals.
Post-trigger failures preserve the durable trigger identity via ReviewerDispatchRefused isolation and internal handling in GitHubBackend.trigger; DPM guard validates the structure.
Orchestration status descriptions are deterministically bounded to <=140 characters using base36 trigger encoding while remaining parseable and legacy-compatible.
